resources.string: A separate blind labeling archive. No automatic predictions are shown and playback is preserved. Isolated preview is not available; choose a whole-recording basis only when you can confirm the song and version.

Unreviewed identities form a training-only, non-independent pilot. Development and sealed tests remain locked until the complete identity graph and lists are frozen. Profiles are selected explicitly; pairing never silently mixes people.
